author: Nadia
text: Our on-call rotation keeps missing handovers. Can we make this boring?

author: Leo
text: We should add a 15-minute handover template: open incidents, risky deploys, expiring certs, and who owns each item.

author: Nadia
text: Decided: the outgoing on-call posts the template in #oncall before 10am, and the incoming on-call replies with explicit acknowledgement.

author: Leo
text: Gotcha: a thread reply is not acknowledgement. Use the checkmark reaction so we can audit it.

author: Nadia
text: Verification: every weekday handover has a checkmark within 30 minutes, and the weekly review lists any misses.

author: Iris
text: We need a safer API key rotation procedure for the billing service.

author: Owen
text: The fix is to introduce the new key first, deploy it to all consumers, wait one full deploy cycle, then revoke the old key.

author: Iris
text: Never revoke before the consumers report the new key version. That caused the outage in July.

author: Owen
text: Verification: call the billing health endpoint with each consumer identity and confirm the key version in the response header.
